My hypothesis was wrong, and the truth is more interesting. The manifest is **not** empty — it has both families, but namespaced:

```
"family": "packages/setlist_ui/DejaVuSans"      ← what gets registered
fontFamily: 'DejaVuSans'                         ← what the widgets ask for
```

11	/// Loads the families the product bundles into the test renderer.
12	///
13	/// A test environment renders text in a glyph-less stub font by default, where
14	/// every character is the same filled box — so two different strings of equal
15	/// length are pixel-identical and a golden accepts either. Measured on this
16	/// toolchain: `THE STAND` and `THE STANE` produced byte-identical renders,
17	/// while a length change produced a 17976px diff. Every requirement that pins
18	/// exact copy is therefore unprovable until this has run.
19	///
20	/// The families are read from the bundle's own `FontManifest.json`, so what the
21	/// harness renders with is whatever the product ships — the two cannot drift
22	/// apart by editing one of them.
23	/// Call this from `setUpAll`, never from inside a test.
24	///
25	/// Reading the bundle from within a `testWidgets` body works exactly once per
26	/// process: the second call never completes, and it presents as the second test
27	/// in the file hanging until its ten-minute timeout rather than as an error.
28	/// `setUpAll` runs outside the per-test zones, so one call there serves every
29	/// test in the file.
30	Future<void> loadProductFonts() async {
31	  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
32	  final manifest = json.decode(
33	    await rootBundle.loadString('FontManifest.json'),
34	  ) as List<dynamic>;
35	
36	  if (manifest.isEmpty) {
37	    throw StateError(
38	      'FontManifest.json declares no families, so every render would use the '
39	      'glyph-less fallback and any golden of it would be blind to copy.',
40	    );
41	  }
42	
43	  for (final entry in manifest.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>()) {
44	    final loader = FontLoader(_bareFamily(entry['family'] as String));
45	    for (final font in (entry['fonts'] as List<dynamic>).cast<Map<String, dynamic>>()) {
46	      loader.addFont(rootBundle.load(font['asset'] as String));

49	  }

53	///
54	/// A package's own fonts appear in its manifest unprefixed, but the same fonts
55	/// seen from a package that *depends* on it are namespaced
56	/// `packages/<package>/<family>`. A `TextStyle` names the bare family either
57	/// way, so registering the manifest's name verbatim loads the bytes under a
58	/// name nothing asks for: the text then renders in the glyph-less fallback, and
59	/// a golden of it is blind to copy while still passing.
60	String _bareFamily(String manifestFamily) {
61	  final match = RegExp(r'^packages/[^/]+/(.+)$').firstMatch(manifestFamily);

104	/// a reader can measure the picture against the spec.

130	    // laid out once more against the new width.

133	      child: Directionality(
134	      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
135	      child: MediaQuery(
136	        data: MediaQueryData(size: bounds),
137	        child: Center(

139	            width: bounds.width,
140	            height: bounds.height,

142	            // tree rather than updating the last one: reused elements keep
143	            // their old slots, and a card ends up laid out against a width the
144	            // screen no longer has.
145	            // The boundary the region crop is taken out of: capturing an
146	            // element needs a layer to read, and the composed screen is the
147	            // only one the product actually draws.
148	            child: RepaintBoundary(

152	          ),

154	      ),
155	    ),

159	  // "settled" never arrives and the wait burns pumpAndSettle's ten-minute
160	  // timeout. A fixed pump also makes an in-flight state a capturable frame
161	  // rather than something that has to be waited out.
162	  await tester.pump();

Both defects from #79, fixed together so the gallery is re-baselined once rather than twice. **Every golden in the diff changed** — that is the point of the change, and for most leaves this is the first time the picture has shown what the line claims.

## What was wrong

**Crops rendered the whole screen.** `matchesGoldenFile` given a `Finder` captures that finder's nearest *ancestor* `RepaintBoundary`. The screen has none per element, so every "cropped" leaf captured the root. Seventeen leaves about seventeen different elements were proved by one identical picture.

**Text rendered as boxes.** `loadProductFonts` registered each family under the name `FontManifest.json` lists. A *dependency's* families are namespaced `packages/<package>/<family>`, while a `TextStyle` names the bare family — so the bytes loaded under a name nothing asked for and every render silently fell back to the glyph-less stub.

My first guess here was wrong and worth recording: I assumed `dev/requirements` declared no fonts and the manifest was empty. It is not — it has both families, under prefixed names. Fixing it by duplicating the font block into a second pubspec would have worked by accident and left the real bug in place for every future consumer.

## What changed

| | |
|---|---|
| `packages/setlist_ui/lib/testing.dart` | Strip the `packages/<pkg>/` prefix before registering a family — a no-op in the package that owns the fonts, the fix in every package that consumes them. Throw if the manifest is empty rather than loading nothing quietly. Add the boundary the crop is read out of. |
| `packages/setlist_ui/lib/src/font_assurance.dart` | The glyph assertion, extracted so both packages run one copy instead of two that can drift. |
| `dev/requirements/shared/snapshot.dart` | Crop the region out of the composed screen — which is what the document always said happened. |
| `dev/requirements/runner_test.dart` | Runs the glyph assurance beside the goldens. |

Distinct screen images go from **8 of 24 to 19**. The five that remain identical are pairs of leaves that genuinely crop the same region (`2.2`/`2.3` on `venue`, `2.4`/`2.5` on `clocks`, `4.1`/`4.2`/`4.5` on `grid`) — allowed, since the bijection is one golden per leaf.

Crops are now element-sized: the countdown is 209×33 where it was 834×1112, the venue line 172×15, the laugh strip 758×10.

## The assurance was in the one package where it cannot fail

It lived only in `setlist_ui` — which owns the fonts, so its manifest is unprefixed and it always passed. It now also runs in `dev/requirements`, and **inside `runner_test.dart`** rather than as a file of its own: a test file at that package's root is run by neither the bare `flutter test` nor `flutter test runner_test.dart`, so it would have existed without ever executing. Beside the goldens, in the command that produces them, is the only place it is load-bearing.

**Watched it fail.** With the prefix fix reverted: the assurance fails first, naming the cause — *"THE STAND and THE STANE rendered identically — the renderer is drawing boxes, not glyphs"* — and nineteen golden cases go red behind it (`+26 -19`). Before this change neither happened.

## Verified

```
core  69      ui  9      requirements  45      gate  57 leaves / 44 claimed / 13 gaps
sweep exit 0
```

## Reviewing this

The goldens are yours to approve and there are 30 of them. The quickest read is the saga strip (`working-the-set.9.1.step-*.png`) — the whole product at once, legible. Then the small crops, each of which should now contain only the thing its leaf names and nothing else.

Closes #79
